topic: Calling IT Help Desk about a Locked Work Account

script.title: THE LOCKED ACCOUNT
script.story_hook: One locked login can ruin a whole morning.
script.intro_zh: 一個鎖住的登入帳號，就能搞砸整個上午。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's help desk call. Listen for unlocking phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的客服求助場景。留意解除帳號鎖定的說法。
script.outro: And that's a locked account opened again. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 鎖住的帳號就這樣重新打開了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his mid twenties with messy sandy blond hair, light stubble, a heather grey hoodie, an office lanyard at his neck, and a tall lanky build
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her late twenties with long straight dark hair pulled into a high ponytail, round clear glasses, a teal polo shirt, and an athletic build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, this is Gabe from sales, my account is locked.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðɪs ɪz ɡeɪb fɹʌm seɪlz maɪ əˈkaʊnt ɪz lɑkt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是業務部的 Gabe，我的帳號鎖住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey Gabe, I can help with that, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ ɡeɪb aɪ kæn hɛlp wɪð ðæt doʊnt ˈwɝi/
dialogue.zh: 嘿 Gabe，這個我能處理，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank goodness, I have a call in an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs aɪ hæv ə kɔl ɪn ən ˈaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 謝天謝地，我一個小時後有場電話會議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, first let me find your username.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ fɝst lɛt mi faɪnd jɔɹ ˈjuzɚˌnɛm/
dialogue.zh: 好，先讓我找出你的使用者名稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Gabe R, the R is for Ramirez.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɡeɪb ɑɹ ði ɑɹ ɪz fɚ ˌɹæməˈɹɛz/
dialogue.zh: 是 Gabe R，R 代表 Ramirez。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Can you confirm your last name?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt kæn ju kənˈfɝm jɔɹ læst neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 收到。請確認一下你的姓氏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ramirez, R A M I R E Z.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɹæməˈɹɛz ɑɹ ˈeɪ ɛm ɑɹ aɪ ˈi zi/
dialogue.zh: Ramirez，R-A-M-I-R-E-Z。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. Now I'll ask two quick security questions.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks naʊ aɪl æsk tu kwɪk sɪˈkjɚəti ˈkwɛstʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。現在我快速問你兩個安全問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, um, go ahead and ask me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ʌm ɡoʊ əˈhɛd ænd æsk mi/
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯，你問吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What street did you grow up on?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt stɹɪt dɪd ju ɡɹoʊ ʌp ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 你從前住在哪條街上？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, Elm Street, near the big park.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɛm stɹɪt nɪɹ ðə bɪɡ pɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，榆樹街，就在那個大公園附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, and what's your favorite team?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd wʌts jɔɹ ˈfeɪvɚɪt tim/
dialogue.zh: 很好，那你最喜歡的隊伍是哪一支？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's tricky, I don't really follow sports.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ ðæts ˈtɹɪki aɪ doʊnt ˈɹɪli ˈfɑloʊ spɔɹts/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這題難倒我了，我其實不看運動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, did you put a pet's name there?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm dɪd ju pʊt ə pɛts neɪm ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，會不會那邊填的是寵物的名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! I used my dog's name, Pepper.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ juzd maɪ dɔɡz neɪm ˈpɛpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有！我用的是我家狗狗的名字，Pepper。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one matches, we're all good now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ˈmætʃəz wɪɹ ɔl ɡʊd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那個對上了，現在沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relief. So am I locked out for good?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈlif soʊ æm aɪ lɑkt aʊt fɚ ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 鬆口氣。那我會不會一直登不進去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I'll reset it right now for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪl ɹiˈsɛt ɪt ɹaɪt naʊ fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 不會，我馬上幫你重設。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, will I get a new password?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt wɪl aɪ ɡɛt ə nu ˈpæswɝd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我會拿到一組新密碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a temp code will text to your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə tɛmp koʊd wɪl tɛkst tə jɔɹ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 會，一組暫時密碼會用簡訊傳到你的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my phone's right here, um, ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ maɪ foʊnz ɹaɪt hɪɹ ʌm ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 好，手機就在手邊，嗯，準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sending it now, it should take a few seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛndɪŋ ɪt naʊ ɪt ʃʊd teɪk ə fjʊ ˈsɛkəndz/
dialogue.zh: 現在就發，應該只要幾秒鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, nothing yet, did it actually go out?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈnʌθɪŋ jɛt dɪd ɪt ˈæktʃuəli ɡoʊ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，還沒有，真的發出去了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me resend, sometimes it lags a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɹiˈsɛnd ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ɪt læɡz ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 讓我重發一次，有時候會慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still nothing, maybe the signal's poor up here.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈmeɪbi ðə ˈsɪɡnəlz pʊɹ ʌp hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 還是沒有，可能我這邊訊號很差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try your wifi instead, that's usually faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹaɪ jɔɹ ˈwaɪfaɪ ɪnˈstɛd ðæts ˈjuʒəwəli ˈfæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 改連你的無線網路看看，通常那個比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, there it is, six digits just popped up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðɛɹ ɪt ɪz sɪks ˈdɪdʒɪts dʒʌst pɑpt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 啊，來了，六個數字剛跳出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, type that in and sign back in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt taɪp ðæt ɪn ænd saɪn bæk ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，把它輸入，再重新登入一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay um, am I supposed to keep this code?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ʌm æm aɪ səˈpoʊzd tə kip ðɪs koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，請問這組密碼我要留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works once, then you set your own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɝks wʌns ðɛn ju sɛt jɔɹ ˈoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 它只能用一次，之後你自己再設一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, and please don't wipe my files.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ænd pliz doʊnt waɪp maɪ faɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 好，拜託別把我的檔案清除掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, no, a reset never touches your files.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ noʊ ə ˈɹiˌsɛt ˈnɛvɚ ˈtʌtʃəz jɔɹ faɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，不會啦，重設絕不會動到你的檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my laptop's still syncing anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪ ˈlæptɑps stɪl ˈsɪŋkɪŋ ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就好，反正我的筆電還在同步中。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it finish, the sync might take a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə sɪŋk maɪt teɪk ə waɪl/
dialogue.zh: 讓它跑完吧，同步可能要花一陣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stay on the line with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ steɪ ɑn ðə laɪn wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 我需要繼續在線上等你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not needed, but I'll keep the ticket open.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈnidəd bʌt aɪl kip ðə ˈtɪkɪt ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 不用，但我會先保留這張工單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's a ticket, and do I need it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wæts ə ˈtɪkɪt ænd du aɪ nid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 工單是什麼？我需要留著它嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's your case number, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts jɔɹ keɪs ˈnʌmbɚ dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 是你的案件編號，留著以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, smart. What number did you give it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ smɑɹt wʌt ˈnʌmbɚ dɪd ju ɡɪv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哦，聰明。你給它的編號是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's four two six, say it back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts fɔɹ tu sɪks seɪ ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 是四二六，麻煩跟我覆誦一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four two six, and I keep that handy?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ tu sɪks ænd aɪ kip ðæt ˈhændi/
dialogue.zh: 四二六，我要把它收好對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, quote it if you call again today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kwoʊt ɪt ɪf ju kɔl əˈɡɛn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，今天若再打來就報這個編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood. Once I'm in, am I fully done?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd wʌns aɪm ɪn æm aɪ ˈfʊli dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 了解。等我登入進去，就全部搞定了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, but pick a strong new password.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli bʌt pɪk ə stɹɔŋ nu ˈpæswɝd/
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，不過你要挑一組強一點的新密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like, a phrase instead of one word?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ə fɹeɪz ɪnˈstɛd ʌv wʌn wɝd/
dialogue.zh: 比如說一整句話，而不只一個單字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, longer is always safer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈlɔŋɡɚ ɪz ˈɔlˌweɪ ˈsæfɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一點都沒錯，密碼越長越安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, I'll change it after this call.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt aɪl tʃeɪndʒ ɪt ˈæftɚ ðɪs kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 收到，這通電話掛掉後我就去改。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, I see you're back in now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ aɪ si jʊɹ bæk ɪn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你看，我這裡已經顯示你登入了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can see that? That's kind of cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn si ðæt ðæts kaɪnd ʌv kul/
dialogue.zh: 你看得見這件事？那還挺酷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my job, I watch the login feed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ dʒɑb aɪ wɑtʃ ðə ˈlɑdʒˌɪn fid/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我的工作，我會盯著登入動態。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, thanks for the quick save today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl θæŋks fɚ ðə kwɪk seɪv təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，多虧你今天幫我快速解圍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Give it ten minutes if it acts up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ɡɪv ɪt tɛn ˈmɪnəts ɪf ɪt ækts ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。要是還鬧脾氣，就等十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Acts up how, still asks for the code?
dialogue.phonetic: /ækts ʌp haʊ stɪl æsks fɚ ðə koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼個鬧法？是還一直要求密碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes it nags twice, then it settles down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ɪt næɡz twaɪs ðɛn ɪt ˈsɛtəlz daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 有時候它會多問兩次，然後就安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, and if it locks again tomorrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ænd ɪf ɪt lɑkts əˈɡɛn təˈmɑɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，那明天萬一又鎖住該怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just reply to the ticket, we're fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ɹɪˈplaɪ tə ðə ˈtɪkɪt wɪɹ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 只要回覆那張工單就好，我們處理很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I think that covers my panic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ θɪŋk ðæt ˈkʌvɚz maɪ ˈpænɪk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我想這樣我的焦慮就安頓好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, this happens more than you'd think.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɪs ˈhæpənz mɔɹ ðæn juːd θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這種事比你想像的常發生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Comforting, I'll save that ticket number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmfɚtɪŋ aɪl seɪv ðæt ˈtɪkɪt ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 聽了真安心，我會把工單編號存好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're set, Gabe, go make that call.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ sɛt ɡeɪb ɡoʊ meɪk ðæt kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 你沒問題了 Gabe，去開你那場會吧。

script.youtube_title: 【工作帳號鎖住了💻】「別清除我的檔案」🙏教你致電IT客服解鎖登入🔒｜聽完就能自己處理｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜IT Help Desk Login Lock
script.youtube_title_en: "Don't Wipe My Files" — Unlocking a Locked Work Account with IT Help Desk
script.youtube_description:
「別清除我的檔案」——一早到公司，登入帳號卻把自己鎖在門外，該怎麼致電 IT 客服把它解開？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在員工撥給 IT 服務台的那通求救電話。

你會聽到：報上部門與使用者名稱、確認姓氏拼法、回答兩個安全問題；一時想不出答案時怎麼換線索、暫時密碼遲遲不到時怎麼改連無線網路；還包括覆誦工單編號、設定新密碼、以及確認筆記型電腦還在同步的實用說法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人講電話的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、okay、hmm。聽完你就會用：let me find your username、a reset never touches your files、say it back、I'll keep the ticket open。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Don't wipe my files" — your work login locks you out first thing in the morning, so how do you call IT help desk and get back in? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around that one urgent call.

You will hear: giving your team and username, confirming how to spell your last name, and answering two security questions; switching clues when one answer blanks you, and tapping wifi when the temp code is slow to arrive; plus reading the ticket number back, setting a strong new password, and checking that your laptop is still syncing.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the real phone texture Americans use: um, well, so, ha, okay, hmm. By the end you'll own phrases like let me find your username, I'll keep the ticket open, and say it back.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧致電IT客服解鎖英文・安全問題與暫時密碼・工單編號覆誦｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
早上剛到辦公室，螢幕卻顯示帳號鎖住登不進去，你該打給誰？要準備哪些身分線索，才不會在電話那頭卡住？工單編號又是拿來做什麼的？

這一集帶大家陪一位業務員致電 IT 服務台，從報上使用者名稱、回答安全問題、收暫時密碼，一路聽到設定新密碼與保留工單編號，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
💻 開場句：Hi, this is Gabe from sales, my account is locked.
🔐 安全問題：Hmm, did you put a pet's name there?
📩 收密碼：Ah, there it is, six digits just popped up.
🧾 工單覆誦：Four two six, and I keep that handy?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、okay、hmm 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這通解鎖電話走一遍，下次帳號出狀況，你就能自己冷靜打給客服。
